⚠️ A forgotten PIN can't be recovered. There is no email or phone number on your account, so nobody can reset it. Write your PIN somewhere safe.

Why make an account?

  • 🌱 The crops and states you look up are kept for you.
  • 🗓️ You get a Farm Year: one page showing when to plant and harvest your own crops. Print it for the wall.
  • 🌦️ Your state's weather is shown first.
  • 🔒 No email, no phone number, no real name.
